name: mistral_hardening_v1
purpose: Canonical prompt contract for Mistral hardening before cross-architecture fan-out.
design_principles: Fail closed on prompt drift: if prompts/bank.json hash changes, this subset is not valid until explicitly re-frozen.
Use the evolved bank.json infrastructure rather than legacy standalone prompt-bank Python files.
Keep the core phenomenon tier balanced and interpretable.
Separate main-effect measurement from confounds, generality, and stress tests.
Preserve the anti-confound moat with dedicated confound, matched-control, and kill-switch panels.

notes: This subset is valid only for prompts/bank.json version 2ac959a313614329.
Future prompt-bank edits require a new subset version rather than silent reuse.

core_measurement.purpose: Primary signed R_V separation, dose-response ladder, and baseline comparison.

selection_rules.notes: Excludes the two DEC8 extras to preserve a balanced 20-prompt ladder level.

confound_panel.purpose: Length/style/keyword confound checks that must stay separate from the main headline effect.

generality_panel.purpose: Cross-framing robustness for non-Western or alternative recursive formulations already in the bank.

champion_stress_panel.purpose: High-signal recursive prompts against matched controls for stronger anti-confound evidence.

kill_switch_panel.purpose: Falsification and boundary tests. These should not be mixed into the main effect estimate.

deliberate_exclusions.reason: These are valuable for later probing, mode atlas work, or historical reproduction, but they increase heterogeneity or historical entanglement and should not define the canonical Mistral hardening contract.

recommended_usage.paper_rule: Do not pool across tiers unless the paper explicitly states why the units and hypotheses are compatible.
